approval: 2026-11-22 user research-design instruction and explicit pi0-based final-selection reply
RQ: 量子計算を活用することで、配送車両の走行距離を短縮しながら、荷物の積み込みを待つ時間も削減できるか。
hypothesis: 量子・古典ハイブリッド最適化手法は、従来型配送計画を共通の初期解とした場合、古典最適化手法よりも総走行距離と荷待ち時間の両立改善率が高い。
common_initial: immutable complete traditional plan generated once; C and D start independently from the same plan
external_A: administrative scalar only; definition and conversion gate required; never optimizer input
dual_domain: D0>0 and W0>0; otherwise undefined and absolute differences only
primary_estimand: I(hybrid method mean D/W | traditional method mean D/W) minus I(classical method mean D/W | traditional method mean D/W), separately by S1/S2/S3
trial_estimand: mean and distribution of trial indices only with verified registered shared-initial triplets
three_separate_judgments: final hybrid D and W both below classical

new_four_branch_selection.zero_W0: minimize W then D then initial first then branch id
new_four_branch_selection.zero_D0: minimize D then W then initial first then branch id
new_four_branch_selection.both_zero: minimize D then W then initial first then branch id
new_four_branch_selection.candidate_set: feasible final plans of four branches plus immutable initial plan
new_four_branch_selection.comparison_arithmetic: exact rational D/W from shared OD and integer schedule; no tolerance relaxes nonworsening

local_acceptance: D_new<=D_current AND W_new<=W_current AND at least one strict improvement; unchanged

statistics.SD: sample standard deviation ddof=1; null for J<2
statistics.box: Tukey 1.5 IQR with observed whisker ends and outliers
statistics.MCSE: SD/sqrt(J) only for justified independent outer quantities; internal J evaluation only
statistics.nonlinear_index_of_means_MCSE: HOLD; never substitute MCSE of trial-index mean
